# Third-party code

This release contains two source components used by the base model:

- Point Transformer V3 is adapted from [Pointcept](https://github.com/Pointcept/Pointcept). The detached implementation retains its original author notice. Pointcept is distributed under the MIT License; see POINTCEPT_LICENSE.
- The bundled CUDA farthest-point sampling extension comes from [Pointnet2_PyTorch](https://github.com/erikwijmans/Pointnet2_PyTorch). Only source files are included. Compiled extensions, build products, package metadata, and the former ZIP archive are excluded. See pointnet2_ops_lib/UNLICENSE.

Please cite the corresponding projects when using these components.
